_comment: One launchd agent (com.jm.mcp-<name>) per server: mcp-proxy wraps the stdio server once and serves it at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp to every Claude session. Keys match the names in ~/.claude.json so mcp__<name>__* tool names do not change. env values are expanded by sh after env_file is sourced; env_file lives in the Syncthing secrets dir, never in git.
